Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: How did the government stand behind the banks through the formation of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation?

Options: 
A. By increasing taxes on banks
B. By guaranteeing loans made by banks to businesses and individuals
C. By capping the interest rates banks can charge on loans
D. By providing financial grants to banks
E. By taking over all private banks
F. By insuring only the deposits of commercial accounts
G. By protecting all bank deposits with government insurance
H. By allowing banks to borrow unlimited funds from the government at zero interest
I. By offering a one-time bailout fund for struggling banks
J. By investing government funds directly into bank stocks

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
